title: Rubric Scoring with Material Criteria
description: This example defines a weighted rubric with material and non-material criteria, scores a candidate's observed behavior, and applies two stopping rules: material failures block convergence, otherwise the threshold decides.

steps.description: The RUBRIC defines a threshold (0.85) and 11 criteria with IDs, requirements, weights, and material flags. Material criteria (K1-K9) must all pass; N1 is non-material.
The candidate dictionary records which criteria this candidate meets. Candidate 0 meets K1-K3, K5, K7-K8 but fails K4 (exit 3), K6 (default 10), and K9 (missing test).
The score function iterates criteria, tallies earned/total weight, collects failed material criteria, and prints each criterion's status. Then it applies the stopping rules.

steps.question: Will this candidate converge, or will it be asked to revise?
steps.answer: Revise. Three material criteria (K4, K6, K9) fail, so convergence is blocked regardless of the score.

steps.description: Each criterion prints with its weight and status: K1-K3, K5, K7-K8 meet; K4, K6, K9 DOES NOT MEET; N1 does not meet (non-material).
Output: revise: material criteria failed: K4, K6, K9.
